tax.text: Ma said she would consider some tax increases but opposes a proposed one-time tax on billionaires.
tax.quote: If elected, Ma would consider some “thoughtfully done” tax increases. But she is opposed to the Billionaire Tax Act

housing.text: Ma says she would expand affordable housing, identify state-owned parcels for development, and push public colleges to build housing for students, faculty and staff.
housing.quote: I will push to identify and prioritize state-owned parcels that are suitable for housing development, particularly affordable and workforce housing

sentencing.text: Ma said she supports the death penalty for people who kill police officers in the line of duty or commit heinous crimes against women and children.
sentencing.quote: Ma supports the death penalty for those who kill police officers in the line of duty or commit heinous crimes against women and children.

abortion.text: Ma said she was proud to stand with a pro-choice organization that supports protecting women and families in California.
abortion.quote: NWPC-CA is at the forefront of electing strong, pro-choice women who fight for equality, economic opportunity, and justice, and Fiona Ma is proud to stand with them to advance women’s leadership and protect women and families across California.

cannabis.text: Ma supports legal cannabis while seeking to replace or substantially overhaul California’s current legalization framework and reduce barriers for licensed businesses.
cannabis.quote: We need to overturn Prop 64. It’s a complete failure

tax.text: Romero said she would not support tax increases or the Billionaire Tax Act and favored controlling spending instead.
tax.quote: Romero would not support tax increases or the Billionaire Tax Act.

housing.text: Romero said housing costs were driven in part by overregulation of building and zoning and called for reevaluating those policies.
housing.quote: The lack of affordability in housing is largely attributable to misplaced priorities and overregulation of building, zoning and running a business.

schools.text: Romero said she supports school vouchers that would let parents use taxpayer funds for private-school education.
schools.quote: Romero, a former Democrat-turned-Republican, supports school vouchers to let parents use taxpayer dollars to pay for private school education

sentencing.text: Romero said she supports the death penalty for serious crimes because victims’ families deserve justice and closure.
sentencing.quote: Romero supports the death penalty for serious crimes because victims’ families deserve justice and closure.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Said she would defend Title IX protections for girls and women in sports.
gender.quote: Romero outlined specific priorities, including standing up for Title IX protections for girls and women in sports

energy.text: Romero opposed banning new gas-powered cars and said oil exploration could provide clean and efficient energy.
energy.quote: California must engage in developing renewable energy projects, particularly oil exploration, which can be clean and efficient.

voting.text: Romero’s campaign promotes a petition supporting voter identification requirements.
